scope: Exposed-data, chat-assisted cross-domain exploration. Not a replay or continuation of the frozen paid cohort and not autonomous unchanged-product output.

source_inspections.mechanism: Retain and score track hypotheses before N-scan commitment.
source_inspections.assessment: Concrete operation from computer vision; no supplied satellite observation model, nuisance clock handling or global-uniqueness guarantee. Full MHT implementation is unnecessary for the currently cost-separated snapshots.

source_inspections.mechanism: Assemble information from joint factors and reject an unobservable global system.
source_inspections.assessment: Linear Gaussian and separate discrete APIs, not a demonstrated mixed nonlinear solver. Existing Satellite QR/SVD already provides the relevant joint computation. Do not import a graph framework.

source_inspections.mechanism: Test observability of a requested function against the joint observation space rather than demanding all snapshot states be independently recoverable.
source_inspections.assessment: Linear structural rank / observer construction is not a guarantee for the nonlinear RF problem. Transfer only the question of joint numerical observability; use the native dynamic fitter's nuisance-eliminated SVD, not structural rank.

hypothesis: The historical five-receiver-per-arc support rule may discard four-receiver arcs whose shared dynamic state and station biases are jointly identifiable over multiple epochs. A native experiment can replace this count restriction with the existing full-rank requirement while preserving physical mask, clocks, noise floors and held-out evaluation.
origin: Parent assistant synthesis after source inspection, using existing paid planner suggestion and native code. No attribution of autonomous discovery or imported solver.

variant.windows: Original twenty chronological windows per candidate, same raw coverage minimum five; no new windows or observations.
variant.admission: Same fixed cost-separated exterior snapshot rule from the already frozen direct comparator; same 10 degree mask at all three training tags. Permit four rather than five surviving receivers, retaining all qualifying windows.
variant.fitter: Native dynamic_fit with only the two explicit prepare minimum-five guards replaced by minimum-four in a transient in-memory copy; union minimum four. Preserve full local nuisance and joint state/bias rank checks at RTOL=1e-10, unchanged physics and solver budgets.
variant.changes_guarantees: Removes per-arc snapshot redundancy and historical count-based support guarantee. Relies on model-conditional joint numerical rank instead; does not establish global observability, unique branches or calibrated physical uncertainty.
unchanged: target product exclusion before numeric parsing
no target radius/state/clock seed or prior
freeze all fits and RF predictions before target oracle scoring
variant.controls: Rebuild five-receiver G13 direct comparator and verify numerical agreement with its frozen fit. Native prepare must still reject unqualified calibrations and reused endpoints; native linearize must still reject a degenerate joint design. No fresh refit claim for historical five controls.
variant.success: At least one newly supported native trajectory or held-out prediction, with full joint numerical rank and visible branch status, compared with original unsupported baseline and frozen direct comparator. Report held-out RF residuals and CODE state discrepancies separately, including worsening. No model/weight/threshold search if unsuccessful.
variant.stop: Exactly one four-receiver variant for each G06/G13. No retry after scientific failure or post-oracle adjustment.

forbidden: No paid API, subagents, new data, product code changes, historical evidence modifications, automatic merge or physical-qualification claim.
